title: Closing thanks
summary: Thanks and the closing of the proceedings.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview

blocks.x: I've been talking to Jimmy Maxwell, trumpet player, over a period of a couple weeks or so, getting some oral history for the Smithsonian Institute.
And it's been a great pleasure, Jimmy. Thank you
very much. I'm sure there's a lot of young people who will get a lot from this. Thank you very much.
Well, thank you. It's been a pleasure to do it with you and an honor to be chosen to do it at all. I keep having the feeling they made a mistake, but I'm delighted to do it.
